records.claim: In the editor project, compact navigation is the default state. This default must not be replaced, though users can manually expand navigation and keep it expanded for the current visit.
records.futureAction: Preserve compact navigation as the default state in the editor. Do not implement changes that replace this default, while ensuring the manual expansion feature remains available for the current visit.

evidence.quote: In our editor, compact navigation is the default. Do not replace that default. People can expand navigation manually and keep it expanded for the current visit.

criteria: Retain compact navigation as the default and preserve the explicitly permitted manual expansion for the current visit.
Do not prohibit expansion, force compact mode after a user override, or invent persistence beyond the current visit.
This specifies product behavior; do not invent a coding-task applicability filter that prevents work on navigation from recalling it.
